data.description:
## Context
Child 2 of 3 under epic acute-agitable-xiphosuran (003c-2dd2-203a-4725), per the operator
decomposition decision of 2026-08-19. Sequenced after the `llm` child because `_commands`
consumes llm's contracts; sequenced before `_engine` because it has the smaller residue and no
external collision.

## Scope
Promote `rebar._commands.*` into tier 1 (`disallow_untyped_defs`) in pyproject.toml and pin it in
`_RATCHET_BASELINE`. Residue measured on main @ ea6ee67e6a: 146 untyped defs, explicit Any count
recorded as 'large' and to be measured at claim time.

## Constraints (inherited from the epic)
- No `cast()`, no `: Any` / `-> Any` to satisfy the ratchet.
- Tier 2 is a separate later step.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `mypy src/rebar/_commands --disallow-untyped-defs` is clean with NO new `: Any` / `-> Any`.
- [ ] `rebar._commands.*` is in the tier-1 override and pinned in `_RATCHET_BASELINE`.
- [ ] No file exceeds the 800 LOC cap; complexity ratchet shows no new/increased entries.
- [ ] Behaviour unchanged: existing tests pass unmodified.
data.title: Promote rebar._commands.* into the mypy tier-1 typing ratchet (146 untyped defs)
